apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Row Level Security (Postgres)
//
// Prisma 7 PSL cannot emit CREATE ROLE, GRANT, ENABLE/FORCE RLS, or POLICY.
// Those statements live at the **bottom** of `migrations/20260818235200_init`
// and MUST stay there when this folder is squashed or regenerated.
//
// Schema-owned pieces (columns, indexes, maps) always land in this file first.
//
// Runtime (apps/api):
//   - Role `app_runtime` (NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOINHERIT NOBYPASSRLS)
//   - GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public + table DML to app_runtime (PG 15+ public
//     schema has no PUBLIC grants — without this, SET ROLE fails with 42501)
//   - RlsPool: SET ROLE app_runtime on every checkout
//   - Session: app.current_user_id, app.rls_bypass (RlsInterceptor ALS)
//   - Helpers: app_rls_bypass(), app_current_user_id(), app_owns(owner_id)
// See docs/prisma.md §10.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

enum Plan {
  FREE
  PRO
  ENTERPRISE
}

enum RedirectType {
  PERMANENT // 301
  TEMPORARY // 302
}

enum DeviceType {
  DESKTOP
  MOBILE
  TABLET
  BOT
  UNKNOWN
}

enum TwoFactorLoginChallengePurpose {
  LOGIN
  ROTATE
}

enum MfaRecoveryRequestStatus {
  PENDING
  APPROVED
  DENIED
  COMPLETED
}

// Enums
enum PermissionAction {
  CREATE
  READ
  UPDATE
  DELETE
  LIST
  MANAGE
}

enum PermissionResource {
  USER
  PROFILE
  ROLE
  PERMISSION
  ADMIN_DASHBOARD
  SYSTEM_SETTINGS
  URL
  TAG
  API_KEY
  ANALYTICS
  AUDIT_LOG
  REPORT
  EMAIL
  GEO
  REWARD
  MERCHANT_ORG
  REDEMPTION
  SAMPLE_CATEGORY
  PRODUCT
  DEVTOOLS
}

// Tables
/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(id)`. Public login/signup uses bypass.
model User {
  id           String  @id @default(uuid())
  fullName     String  @db.VarChar(100)
  email        String  @unique @db.VarChar(100)
  passwordHash String  @db.Text
  isActive     Boolean @default(true)
  isSuperAdmin Boolean @default(false)

  // Incremented on every role/permission mutation. The JWT carries this
  // value; the AuthorizationGuard rejects tokens with a stale version,
  // forcing the user to re-login (or refresh) after an authorization
  // change — without needing Redis or a token blacklist.
  tokenVersion Int @default(0) @map("token_version")

  failedLoginAttempts Int     @default(0) @map("failed_login_attempts")
  lockedUntil         BigInt? @map("locked_until")

  twoFactorEnabled          Boolean @default(false) @map("two_factor_enabled")
  /// DEPRECATED: plaintext TOTP secret — migrate to encrypted columns in service layer.
  twoFactorSecret           String? @map("two_factor_secret") @db.Text
  twoFactorSecretCiphertext String? @map("two_factor_secret_ciphertext") @db.Text
  twoFactorSecretIv         String? @map("two_factor_secret_iv") @db.VarChar(32)
  twoFactorSecretKeyVersion Int?    @map("two_factor_secret_key_version")
  twoFactorLastTotpStep     BigInt? @map("two_factor_last_totp_step")
  mfaEnrolledAt             BigInt? @map("mfa_enrolled_at")
  mfaEnrollmentDeadline     BigInt? @map("mfa_enrollment_deadline")
  mfaAssuredAt              BigInt? @map("mfa_assured_at")

  provider          String? // "google" | "github" | null
  providerId        String? @map("provider_id")
  plan              Plan    @default(FREE)
  monthlyUrlLimit   Int     @default(50) @map("monthly_url_limit")
  monthlyClickLimit Int     @default(10000) @map("monthly_click_limit")

  // Relations
  refreshTokens   RefreshToken[]
  userRoles       UserRole[]
  userPermissions UserPermission[]

  emailVerifiedAt             BigInt?                   @map("email_verified_at")
  phone                       String?                   @db.VarChar(20)
  phoneVerifiedAt             BigInt?                   @map("phone_verified_at")
  lastLoginAt                 BigInt?                   @map("last_login_at")
  pendingAttributionToken     String?                   @map("pending_attribution_token") @db.VarChar(64)
  pendingAttributionExpiresAt BigInt?                   @map("pending_attribution_expires_at")
  isDeleted                   Boolean                   @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt                   BigInt?                   @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt                   BigInt                    @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt                   BigInt                    @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  urls                        Url[]
  tags                        Tag[]
  apiKeys                     ApiKey[]
  passwordResetTokens         PasswordResetToken[]
  passwordHistory             PasswordHistory[]
  backupCodes                 BackupCode[]
  twoFactorPendingSetup       TwoFactorPendingSetup?
  twoFactorLoginChallenges    TwoFactorLoginChallenge[]
  mfaRecoveryRequests         MfaRecoveryRequest[]
  impersonatedBy              ImpersonationAuditLog[]   @relation("Impersonator")
  impersonatedUser            ImpersonationAuditLog[]   @relation("ImpersonationTarget")

  merchantMembers           MerchantMember[]
  merchantApiKeysCreated    MerchantApiKey[]        @relation("MerchantApiKeyCreator")
  merchantInvitesCreated    MerchantInvite[]        @relation("MerchantInviteCreator")
  merchantInvitesAccepted   MerchantInvite[]        @relation("MerchantInviteAcceptor")
  rewardClaims              RewardClaim[]
  rewardRedemptions         RewardRedemption[]
  rewardReferralsAsReferrer RewardReferral[]        @relation("ReferrerUser")
  rewardReferralsAsReferee  RewardReferral[]        @relation("RefereeUser")
  rewardOtpChallenges       RewardOtpChallenge[]
  rewardLegalAcceptances    RewardLegalAcceptance[]
  rewardNotifications       RewardNotification[]
  rewardAuditLogs           RewardAuditLog[]

  @@unique([provider, providerId])
  @@index([pendingAttributionToken])
  @@map("users")
}

/// RLS: catalog — SELECT true; writes need `app_rls_bypass()`.
model Role {
  id          String  @id @default(uuid())
  name        String  @unique @db.VarChar(100)
  description String? @db.Text
  isActive    Boolean @default(true)

  // Self-referential hierarchy — a role can inherit permissions from a parent role.
  parentId String? @map("parent_id")
  parent   Role?   @relation("RoleHierarchy", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  children Role[]  @relation("RoleHierarchy")

  // Relations
  userRoles       UserRole[]
  rolePermissions RolePermission[]

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))

  @@index([parentId])
  @@map("roles")
}

/// RLS: catalog — SELECT true; writes need `app_rls_bypass()`.
model Permission {
  id          String             @id @default(uuid())
  action      PermissionAction
  resource    PermissionResource
  description String?            @db.Text

  group      String? @db.VarChar(100)
  isSystem   Boolean @default(false)
  conditions Json?

  // Relations
  rolePermissions      RolePermission[]
  userPermissions      UserPermission[]
  capabilityDefinition CapabilityDefinition?

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))

  @@unique([action, resource])
  @@map("permissions")
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Capability catalog (generic RBAC slugs — platform + tenant scopes)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

enum CapabilityScope {
  PLATFORM
  MERCHANT
  ADMIN
}

/// RLS: catalog — SELECT true; writes need `app_rls_bypass()`.
model CapabilityDefinition {
  id           String          @id @default(uuid())
  slug         String          @unique @db.VarChar(100)
  scope        CapabilityScope
  label        String          @db.VarChar(200)
  description  String?         @db.Text
  groupName    String?         @map("group_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  sortOrder    Int             @default(0) @map("sort_order")
  isSystem     Boolean         @default(false) @map("is_system")
  permissionId String?         @unique @map("permission_id")
  metadata     Json?

  permission         Permission?              @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  merchantRoleGrants MerchantRoleCapability[]

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("updated_at")

  @@index([scope])
  @@map("capability_definitions")
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Permission Audit Trail
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// RLS: bypass only (`app_rls_bypass()`).
model PermissionAuditLog {
  id           String  @id @default(uuid())
  actorId      String  @map("actor_id")
  targetUserId String? @map("target_user_id")
  targetRoleId String? @map("target_role_id")
  permissionId String? @map("permission_id")
  action       String
  detail       String? @db.Text
  isDeleted    Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt    BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt    BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("updated_at")

  @@index([actorId])
  @@index([targetUserId])
  @@index([targetRoleId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("permission_audit_logs")
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Password Reset Tokens
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`.
model PasswordResetToken {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String  @map("user_id")
  token     String  @unique @db.Text
  expiresAt BigInt  @map("expires_at")
  usedAt    BigInt? @map("used_at")
  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("updated_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([token])
  @@map("password_reset_tokens")
}

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`.
model PasswordHistory {
  id           String @id @default(uuid())
  userId       String @map("user_id")
  passwordHash String @map("password_hash") @db.Text
  createdAt    BigInt @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@map("password_history")
}

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`.
model BackupCode {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String  @map("user_id")
  codeHash  String  @map("code_hash") @db.Text
  usedAt    BigInt? @map("used_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("backup_codes")
}

/// Temporary 2FA enrollment state — expires after 15 minutes.
/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`.
model TwoFactorPendingSetup {
  id                String @id @default(uuid())
  userId            String @unique @map("user_id")
  secretCiphertext  String @map("secret_ciphertext") @db.Text
  secretIv          String @map("secret_iv") @db.VarChar(32)
  secretKeyVersion  Int    @map("secret_key_version")
  backupCodesHashes Json   @map("backup_codes_hashes")
  expiresAt         BigInt @map("expires_at")
  createdAt         BigInt @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@map("two_factor_pending_setups")
}

/// Short-lived MFA verification challenge during login or secret rotation.
/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`.
model TwoFactorLoginChallenge {
  id           String                         @id @default(uuid())
  userId       String                         @map("user_id")
  purpose      TwoFactorLoginChallengePurpose
  clientType   String?                        @map("client_type")
  deviceInfo   String?                        @map("device_info") @db.VarChar(255)
  ipAddress    String?                        @map("ip_address") @db.VarChar(45)
  attemptCount Int                            @default(0) @map("attempt_count")
  maxAttempts  Int                            @default(5) @map("max_attempts")
  consumedAt   BigInt?                        @map("consumed_at")
  expiresAt    BigInt                         @map("expires_at")
  createdAt    BigInt                         @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("two_factor_login_challenges")
}

/// Admin-reviewed MFA recovery / account unlock request.
/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`.
model MfaRecoveryRequest {
  id                String                   @id @default(uuid())
  userId            String                   @map("user_id")
  status            MfaRecoveryRequestStatus @default(PENDING)
  requestedAt       BigInt                   @map("requested_at")
  reviewedBy        String?                  @map("reviewed_by")
  reviewedAt        BigInt?                  @map("reviewed_at")
  scheduledUnlockAt BigInt?                  @map("scheduled_unlock_at")
  completedAt       BigInt?                  @map("completed_at")
  notes             String?                  @db.Text
  createdAt         BigInt                   @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         BigInt                   @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("updated_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status])
  @@map("mfa_recovery_requests")
}

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns("userId")`.
model UserRole {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  userId String
  roleId String

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role Role @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  assignedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  assignedBy String?

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))

  @@unique([userId, roleId])
  @@map("user_roles")
}

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns("userId")`.
model UserPermission {
  id           String @id @default(uuid())
  userId       String
  permissionId String

  user       User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  permission Permission @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  assignedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  assignedBy String?
  expiresAt  BigInt?

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))

  @@unique([userId, permissionId])
  @@map("user_permissions")
}

/// RLS: catalog — SELECT true; writes need `app_rls_bypass()`.
model RolePermission {
  id           String @id @default(uuid())
  roleId       String
  permissionId String

  role       Role       @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  permission Permission @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  assignedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  assignedBy String?

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))

  @@unique([roleId, permissionId])
  @@map("role_permissions")
}

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns("userId")`.
model RefreshToken {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  token  String @db.Text
  userId String
  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  deviceInfo String? @db.VarChar(255)
  ipAddress  String? @db.VarChar(45)

  expiresAt BigInt
  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([token])
  @@map("refresh_tokens")
}

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`. Public redirects use bypass.
model Url {
  id           String       @id @default(uuid())
  userId       String?      @map("user_id")
  shortCode    String       @unique @map("short_code")
  customAlias  String?      @unique @map("custom_alias")
  originalUrl  String       @map("original_url") @db.Text
  title        String?
  redirectType RedirectType @default(TEMPORARY) @map("redirect_type")
  isActive     Boolean      @default(true) @map("is_active")
  passwordHash String?      @map("password_hash")
  clickLimit   Int?         @map("click_limit")
  clickCount   Int          @default(0) @map("click_count")
  expiresAt    BigInt?      @map("expires_at")
  isDeleted    Boolean      @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt    BigInt?      @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt    BigInt       @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    BigInt       @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("updated_at")

  user   User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  clicks Click[]
  tags   UrlTag[]

  @@index([shortCode])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@index([deletedAt])
  @@map("urls")
}

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`.
model Tag {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String  @map("user_id")
  name      String
  color     String  @default("#6366f1")
  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("updated_at")

  user User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  urls UrlTag[]

  @@unique([userId, name])
  @@map("tags")
}

/// RLS: via parent url — `app_owns(urls.user_id)`.
model UrlTag {
  id    String @id @default(uuid())
  urlId String @map("url_id")
  tagId String @map("tag_id")

  url Url @relation(fields: [urlId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tag Tag @relation(fields: [tagId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt BigInt? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))

  @@unique([urlId, tagId])
  @@map("url_tags")
}

/// RLS: via parent url — `app_owns(urls.user_id)`.
model Click {
  id          String     @id @default(uuid())
  urlId       String     @map("url_id")
  ipAddress   String?    @map("ip_address")
  country     String?
  city        String?
  deviceType  DeviceType @default(UNKNOWN) @map("device_type")
  os          String?
  browser     String?
  referrer    String?    @db.Text
  utmSource   String?    @map("utm_source")
  utmMedium   String?    @map("utm_medium")
  utmCampaign String?    @map("utm_campaign")
  clickedAt   BigInt     @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("clicked_at")
  isDeleted   Boolean    @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt   BigInt?    @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt   BigInt     @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  updatedAt   BigInt     @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  url         Url        @relation(fields: [urlId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([urlId])
  @@index([clickedAt])
  @@index([urlId, clickedAt])
  @@map("clicks")
}

/// RLS: own row — `app_owns(user_id)`.
model ApiKey {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String   @map("user_id")
  name          String
  keyHash       String   @unique @map("key_hash")
  keyPrefix     String   @map("key_prefix")
  scopes        String[] @default(["read", "write"])
  rateLimitTier String   @default("standard") @map("rate_limit_tier")
  totalRequests Int      @default(0) @map("total_requests")
  lastUsedAt    BigInt?  @map("last_used_at")
  expiresAt     BigInt?  @map("expires_at")
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  isDeleted     Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  deletedAt     BigInt?  @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt     BigInt   @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     BigInt   @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("updated_at")

  user      User             @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  usageLogs ApiKeyUsageLog[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([keyHash])
  @@index([deletedAt])
  @@map("api_keys")
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Impersonation Audit Log
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// RLS: INSERT + SELECT need `app_rls_bypass()`; UPDATE/DELETE revoked for `app_runtime` (immutable audit).
model ImpersonationAuditLog {
  id             String  @id @default(uuid())
  impersonatorId String  @map("impersonator_id")
  targetUserId   String  @map("target_user_id")
  action         String // "START" | "STOP"
  ipAddress      String? @map("ip_address") @db.VarChar(45)
  userAgent      String? @map("user_agent") @db.Text
  createdAt      BigInt  @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint")) @map("created_at")

  impersonator User @relation("Impersonator", fields: [impersonatorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  targetUser   User @relation("ImpersonationTarget", fields: [targetUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([impersonatorId])
  @@index([targetUserId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("impersonation_audit_logs")
}

/// RLS: INSERT open (request capture); SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE need bypass.
model Log {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  level         String
  message       String   @db.Text
  context       String?
  userId        String?
  correlationId String?  @map("correlation_id")
  metadata      Json?
  durationMs    Int?     @map("duration_ms")
  errorGroup    String?  @map("error_group")
  tags          String[] @default([])
  timestamp     BigInt   @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))
  createdAt     BigInt   @default(dbgenerated("(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint"))

  @@index([level])
  @@index([timestamp])
  @@index([context])
